Wajibu wa Mume kwa Mkewe

Katika jamii za kikafiri, mwanamke alifanywa kama mtumishi au kama mtumwa. Katika baadhi ya jamii hizo, mwanamke aliangaliwa kama kifaa kingine cha nyumbani. Kwa upande mwingine, mwanamume katika jamii hizi hakuwa na wajibu wowote kwa mkewe, bali mkewe ndiye tu aliyelazimika kuwajibika kwa bwana wake. Mpaka hivi leo, katika jamii nyingi uhusiano wa mume na mke ni ule wa "Bwana" na "Mtumwa" wake. Uhusiano wa mume na mke katika Uislamu ni ule wa mtu na mwenzie au mtu na mpenzi wake. Tumeshaona kuwa uhusiano huu wa mume na mke ndio lengo kuu Ia ndoa. Kama tunavyojifunza katika Qur-an:

"Na katika ishara zake ni kuwa amekuumbieni wake zenu katika jinsi yenu iii mpate utulivu kwao, naye amejaalia mapenzi na huruma baina yenu " (30:21).
Mapenzi na huruma baina ya Mke na Mume vitakuwepo tu endapo kila mmoja atatekeleza wajibu wake kwa mwenziwe kwa kadiri ya uwezo wake na kwa upendo na huruma. Mume anawajibika kwa mkewe:

(i)Kumlisha, kumvisha na kumpatia makazi
Mwanamume na amgharimie mkewe kwa kadri ya uwezo wake.

Mwenye wasaa agharamike kadri ya wasaa wake, na yule ambaye amepungukiwa riziki yake, atoe katika idle alichopewa na Mwenyezi Mungu; Mwenyezi Mungu hamkalflshi mtu yeyote ila kwa kadri ya alichompa. Atajaalia Mwenyezi Mungu baada ya dhikifaraja. (65:7).

(ii)Kumtendea wema, kumhurumia na kumpenda

Na kaeni nao kwa wema; na kama mkiwachukia basi (msiwawache) kwani huenda mkachukia kitu, na Mwenyezi Mungu ametia kheri nyingi ndani yake. (4:19).
Katika hadithi iliyosimuliwa na Aisha (r.a), Mtume (s.a.w) amesema:

Mbora miongoni mwenu ni yule aliye mbora katika (kuwatendea wema) familia yake na ni mbora wenu katika familia yangu... (Ibn Majah).
Pia Abu Hurairah (r.a) kasimulia kuwa Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu amesema: Muislamu aliyekamilika kweli kweli miongoni mwenu katika imani ni yule aliye mbora wao katika tabia, na wabora katika nyinyi ni wale ambao ni wabora kwa wake zao. (Tirmidhs, Abu Daud).

Katika Qur-an na hadithi wanaume wamesisitizwa sana kuwafanyia wema wake zao, na kuwaonyesha upendo na huruma. Iii kuzidisha mapenzi, inapendekezwa kwa mwanamume kuwa, pamoja na kumpatia mkewe mahitaji muhimu, mara kwa mara amletee zawadi kila atakapopata wasaa. Vile vile, mume ameshauriwa mara kwa mara apate muda wa kucheza na kutoka na mkewe kwa matembezi. Tunajifunza katika hadithi nyingi kuwa Mtume (s.a.w) alikuwa akicheza na wakeze na kufanya maskhara nao.

(iii)Kujizuia na kumchukia mkewe
Chuki ni kinyume cha upendo. Kumchukia mke ni doa kubwa katika nyumba, hivyo mwanamume anatakiwa ajitahidi kujiepusha na kumchukia mkewe, kwa kuyabeza maudhi madogo madogo yasiyo ya msingi kama Mtume (s.a.w) anavyotushauri katika hadithi ifuatayo:

Abu Hurairah(r.a) ameeleza kuwa Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu amesema: "Mwanamume aliyeamini asimchukie mwanamke aliyeamini. Kama anachukia kipengele kimoja cha tabia yake, atafurahishwa na kipengele kingine kizuri katika tabia yake. (Muslim).

Hadithi hii inasisitiza kuvumiliana kwa kuyaangalia mazuri ya mtu na kuyafumbia macho mabaya yake. Kwani ni muhali mwanaadamu kukosa mabaya, angalau kidogo. Hakuna binaadamu aliyekamilika

(iv)Kujizuia kumpiga au kuwa mkali sana kwake:
Mwanamume haruhusiwi kumpiga mkewe kwa makosa madogo madogo. Haruhusiwi kumpiga fimbo au kofi Ia usoni bali anaruhusiwa kumpiga kwa nguo au mti wa mswaki kiasi cha kumpa onyo. Kabla ya kufikia hatua hii ya kuwapa onyo Ia kipigo hiki hafifu, tumeambiwa katika Qur-an tuwaonye kwa mawaidha na tuwahame katika vitanda mpaka watakapojirekebisha (4:34). Mtume (s.a.w) ametushauri katika hadithi mbali mbali kuwa, tuwe na subira na ustahamilivu juu ya wake zetu, kama tunavyojifunza katika hadithi ifuatayo:

ilyas bin Abdullah (r.a) ameeleza kuwa Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu amesema: "Msiwapige v/akazi vya Mwenyezi Mungu (wanawake). Kisha Umar(r.a) alikuja kwa Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu akasema: Wanawake wanawakalia (hawawajali waume zao sasa. Kwa hivyo (Mtume) aliwaruhusu wawapige. Kesho yake (baada ya ruhusa hii) wanawake wengi wakawa wanaranda randa katika mazingira ya nyumba ya Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu wakilalamika dhidi ya waume zao. Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu akasema: "Wanawake wamerandaranda nyumbani kwa Muhammad wakilalamika dhidi ya waume zao. Wanaume hao sio bora miongoni mwenu." (Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah).

Hadithi hii inatuweka wazi kuwa, japo kupiga kunaruhusiwa, lakini kisiwe kipigo kikubwa cha kuumiza. Hata hicho kipigo hafifu si jambo linalopendeza mbele ya Mwenyezi Mungu (s.w) na Mtume wake. Mtume (s.a.w) ambaye ni kiigizo chetu, hatuoni popote alipothubutu kumnyoshea mkono, yeyote katika wake zake, japo baadhi yao walikuwa wakorofi. Tunajifunza kuwa kutokana na ukorofi wa wakeze, aliwahi kuwahama kwa kipindi cha mwezi mmoja. Iii tuweze kuishi vizuri na wake zetu, hatuna budi kuwavumilia na kuwachukulia kuwa ndilo umbile lao, kama Mtume (s.a.w) anavyotushauri katika hadithi zifuatazo:

Abu Hurairah (r.a) ameeleza kuwa Mtume wa Allah amesema: Kuweni wema kwa wanawake, kwani wameumbwa kutokana na sehemu ya juu ya ubavu, na sehemu iliyopinda kuliko zote katika ubavu ni sehemu yajuu. Kwa hiyo kama utataka kuinyoosha utaivunja, na kama utaiacha hivyo hivyo itaendelea kupinda. Kwa hiyo wawaidhini wanawake (waonyeni) kwa kadri iwezekanavyo. (Bukhari na Muslim).

Abu Hurairah (r.a) ameeleza kuwa Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu amesema: "Hakika mwanamke ameumbwa kutokana na ubavu ambao kamwe hautakunyookea unavyotaka (kupinda ndio umbile lake). Kama unamfurahia mkeo, utamfurahia pamoja na kupinda kwake, kama utataka kunyoosha, utamvunja, na kuvunjika kwake ni talaka. (Muslim).
Hadithi hizi zinatuthibitishia kuwa, hapana mtu atakayedumu na mkewe, kama hapatakuwa na kuvumiliana. Mwanamume asimtegemee mkewe kuwa na msimamo kama ule wake, ajue kuwa kila mmoja, kulingana na nafasi yake ana umbile tofauti. Hivyo ni lazima wanaume wawe wavumilivu sana kwa wake zao ili papatikane amani, upendo na furaha katika familia.

(v)Kutunza Sin za Unyumba:
Ni jambo baya sana mbele ya Mwenyezi Mungu (s.w) mtu kutoa sin za nyumbani kupeleka nje hasa zile zinazohusu unyumba. Utoaji wa sin za unyumba unaondoa uaminifu kati ya mke na mume, unaondoa upendo kati yao, na unatoa mwanya kwa maadui kuwaingilia na kuvunja nyumba yao.

(vi)Kuwa Muadilifu:
Mwanamume akiwa na mke zaidi ya mmoja, awe muadilifu na kuwagawia haki zao pasina upendeleo wowote. Ikitokea kuwa kuna kitu ambacho hakiwezekani kugawanyika itabidi wake zake wote waamue kwa pamoja kuwa nani kati yao apate kitu hicho kwa niaba ya wengine Ia sivyo itapigwa kura, na kitu hicho kitakuwa ni cha yule atakayeangukiwa na kura. Mtume (s.a.w) ambaye ni kiigizo chetu, alikuwa muadilifu mno na mwenye kugawa haki sawa kwa wake zake kama tunavyojifunza katika hadithi ifuatayo:

Aysha (r.a) ameeleza kuwa Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu alikuwa akigawanya ngono kwa wake zake kwa usawa. Alikuwa akisema: "Ee Mwenyezi Mungu huu ndio mgawanyo wangu kulingana na uwezo wangu. Hivyo usinipatilize kwa idle ulicho na mamlaka nacho, ambacho mimi sina. (Tirmidh, Ahmed, Nisai).

Mtu kupendelea baadhi ya wakeze katika kuwapa haki zao, ni jambo baya mno, ambalo linaweza likawa ndio sababu ya mtu kuingia motoni kama tunavyojifunza katika hadithi ifuatayo:

Abu Hurairah(r.a) ameeleza kuwa Mtume (s.a.w) amesema: Mtu mwenye wake wawili akawa anampendelea mmoja kati yao, atakuwa siku ya Kiyama na upande mmoja unaoning 'inia chini. (Tirmidh, Abu Daud, Nisai).

Mwanamume akijitahidi kumpa mkewe haki zake na akawa muadilifu kwake, akajitahidi kuonesha mahaba kwake na akawa mvumilivu na mwenye subira juu ya udhaifu wake, kwa vyovyote vile atapendana na kushikamana vilivyo na mkewe endapo mkewe atakuwa ni Muumini na mcha-Mungu.

(vii) Kusimamia maadili ya kiislamu na ucha-Mungu
Ni wajibu wa mwanamume wa Kiislamu kuhakikisha kuwa mkewe/wakeze wanaujua Uislamu kwa usahihi wake na kujitahidi kuwa wacha-Mungu katika kukiendea kila kipengele cha maisha yao ya kibinafsi, kifamilia na kijamii. Pamoja na jitihada za wanaume wa kiislamu katika kusimamia maadili ya wake zao, ikiwa ni pamoja na kuwaamrisha mema na kuwakataza maovu, hawanabudi kuomba msaada wa Allah (s.w) kwa kuleta dua aliyotufunza:

"... Mola wetu! Tupe katika wake zetu na watoto wetu yaburudishayo macho (yetu) na utujaalie kuwa waongozi kwa wamchao Mwenyezi Mungu "(25:74).
Uamrishaji mema na ukatazaji mabaya kwa wake zetu hautakuwa na athari yoyote kama hatutakuwa kiigizo chema katika kufanya mema na kuacha maovu.
Mwanamke anapovunja amri ya Allah (s.w) na Mtume wake, mumewe amuonyeshe ubaya alioufanya na amuhimize kuleta toba ya kweli kama Allah (s.w) anavyotuamrisha:

Enyi mlioamini! Tubuni kwa Mwenyezi Mungu toba iliyo ya kweli; huenda Mola wenu akakufutieni maovu yenu na kukuingizeni katika Pepo zipitazo mito mbele yake, siku ambayo Mwenyezi Mungu hatamdhalilisha Mtume wala wale walioamini pamoja naye; nuru yao itakuwa inakwenda mbele yao na pande zao za kulia (na kushoto); na huku wanasema: 'Mola wetu! Tutimizie nuru yetu, na utughufirie, hakika wewe ni Mwenye uwezajuu ya kila kitu". (66:8).

Mke akirudia kosa Ia kumuasi Allah (s.w) na Mtume wake, mumewe amuase kwa mawaidha makali akionyesha kutoridhika kwake kutokana na uasi wake na akirudia tena kukaidi mume ajitenge naye kitandani kama kiashiria cha mwisho wa kumvumilia. Talaka itakuwa hainabudi kama mke huyo atazidi kukaidi kwa kuzingatia aya ifuatayo:

"Sema: Kama baba zenu na wana wenu na ndugu zenu na wake zenu na jamaa zenu, ni vpenzi zaidi kwenu kuliko Mwenyezi Mungu na Mtume wake na kupigania Dini yake, Basi ngojeni mpaka Mwenyezi Mungu alete amri yake; na Mwenyezi Mungu hawaongozi watu waasi" (9:24)

"Naendelea vizuri nimeshpata vipimo na dawa..." alijibu Emmy uku akimuangalia Steve na kujitaidi kutabasamu.

Wakiwa wanaendelea kupiga story za hapa na pale, gafla mlango ulifunguliwa na City ndiyw mtu pekee ambaye aliingia chumbani umo akiwa na hasira sana.

Kwa upande wa Steve alishashuka dirishani na kukimbia muda mrefu tu.

"Umepatwa na nini ??" Emmy alimuuliza city.

"Hizi siku za karibuni, Steve amekua akibehave tofauti sana, nawaza sijui atakuwa na mwanamke mwengine au laah, na kama ni kweli huyo mwanamke atajuta kunifahamu " alizungumza City kwa hasira.

"Na kwanini unasema hivyo ?? "

"Ameniacha kwenye chumba cha chakula, na kusema kuwa atarudi anaenda uwani, zaidi ya dakika 15 zimepita sioni mtu akija nampigia simu zangu apokei, nimeenda chumbani kwao hayupo " alifoka city.

Emmy alibaki akiogopa sana kwani mwanaume wa city ndio alikuwa hapo muda mfupi tu wakila story za hapa na pale.

Majila ya jioni, familia ya watu wa tano walikutana na kwenye chumba cha kina Emmy kwaajili ya kumuona Emmy ambaye alishindwa ata kutoka nje.

"Sema Emmy ni muoga wa kuumwa, yaani siku moja tu tayali umebaki kichwa...." Alizungumza Mike akimtania Emmy.

"Ila Mike mbona mkorofi sana, muda wote unampa shida Emmy wa watu" alizungumza Steve ambaye kwa muonekano tu unajua ameanza kukolea kwa Emmy .

"Me namwambia ukweli tu kuwa amebaki fuvu " alizungumza Mike uku akicheka sana.

Muda huo huo ujumbe wa simu uliingia kwenye simu ya Emmy, haraka akavuta simu yake na kusoma.

"Aiseeeh wewe ni pisi...." ulikuwa ni ujumbe ambayo Emmy aliusoma na ulitoka kwa Steve.

Amo alihisi uwoga sana, maana ameshasikia vitisho vya City kuhusu mpenzi wake halafu leo hii, mwanaume wa city anatumia nguvu zake za ziada kuteka akili ya Emmy.

Kwakuwa haikuwa ikiruhusiwa watoto wa kiume kuingia kwenye dom za wanawake, vijana wale watatu, yaani Mike, Liam na Steve, walitumia dirisha kutoka nje.

"See my man anajali sana, ndio maana nampenda kumbe muda ule nalalamkka ameenda wapi, alikuwa ameenda kufata saa aliyoninunulia kama zawadi ili aje kunipa ni wasiwasi wangu tu " alizungumza City kwa kudeka, akiamini kuwa amepata mwanaume aswaah.

"Wanaume wataendelea kuwa wanaume " alizungumza Emmy kimoyomoyo, maana anajua kabisa mwanaume alikuwa kwa Emmy muda wote.

***

Siku iliyofuata hali ya Emmy ilikaa powa kwani maumivu ya tumbo yaliisha, aliudhulia vipindi vya darasani kama kawaida.

Baada ya muda, Emmy alitoka darasani na kwenda uwani, akiwa kwenye Kordo za wanafunzi wa kike, alistuka kusikia sauti ambazo akuwa akizielewa kabisa alijikuta akicheka tu.

Alifika darasani akiwa na kimuhemuhe sana.

Akavuta simu yake na kutuma ujumbe kwenye group lao la watu watano akitaka kuwaambia jambo.

Muda wa mapumziko wote wwlikutana sehemu ambayo wamezoea kukutana na Emmy alionekana kuwa muoga Sana.

"Kuna nini maana umetushtua mno," City aliuliza.

"Sijui naiwekaje hii lakini naweza kusema kuwa principle anatania mbaya sana, anachezea wanafunzi wa shule na kuwadanganya na vitu vidogo dogo " alizungumza Emmy.

Mike alimsogelea Emmy chap na kumziba mdomo.

"Una kichaa wewe ? Ni issue kubwa sana hiyo unayoongelea ujue unaweza kuharibu maisha ya mtu kwq muda mfupi tu " alizungumza Mike uku akiangalia uku na uku.

"Tunsikilize kwanza ni nini kimemfanya aseme hivyo " alizungumza City.

Basi Emmy akapata muda wa kuelezea, kuanzia siku ya kwanza lipokutana na principle kule supermarket mpaka tukio la mara ya mwisho alipomuona principle akiwa na mwanafunzi.

"Nafikili umechukulia uchangamfu wake kwa wanafunzi kwa njia nyingine kabisa" Mike akaongezea akionesha kutokumuamini Emmy..

"Ninachoongea nina uhakika nacho, na kama tutafumbia macho wanafunzi wa kike wa shule hii watateketea " alizungumza Emmy akiwa anamaanisha anachozungumza.

"Tumeitia wito" walizungumza kwa pamoja.

"Sasa, Steve nimekuita hapa nataka uwe karibu kabisa na Emmy, Emmy ni mchezaji mzuri sana wa netball shangazi yake amenisibitishia ilo, lakini pia shule aliyotoka imesibitisha, ni vile tu ajiamini " alizungumza principle uku akimuangalia Emmy.

"Aaah principle, samahani kama nitakosea, lakini kwa sasa hivi sizani kama niko tayali kuendelea na huo mchezo," alizungumza Emmy.

"Naelewa na ndio maana nataka kukusaidia, nina historia yako yote usijali sawa ? Unavyomuona Steve pia alikuwa muoga kama wewe lakini tazama kwa sasa alipo " alizungumza principle.

"Last October, Geshe Jigme Lodoe, a Tibetan Buddhist monk of the Dalai Lama's monastery in Dharamshala, was a month-long guest at Gethsemani Abbey and conducted research at the Thomas Merton Center on the dialogue between Merton and the Dalai Lama. He sent a Christmas message relating that he had shared his studies with his monastic community."

➖➖➖

"Originally from Tibet, Geshe Jigme Lodoe relocated to Dharamsala, India, where he achieved the prestigious Geshe degree. A significant part of his narrative involves his study of the life and writings of Thomas Merton, an American Trappist monk. Geshe Jigme Lodoe has focused on Merton’s dialogue with Tibetan Buddhism, even visiting Merton's former hermitage and the Gethsemani monastery as part of his research.

 He is the author of Tibetan Buddhist Monastic Literature, which was one of five publications launched by the Library of Tibetan Works and Archives (LTWA) during its golden jubilee in 2020 to expand resources for Buddhist studies. Through his work with the LTWA, he has been an active participant in preserving Tibetan culture and history, particularly through scholarly translation and research exchange."

➖

"In November 1968, the American Trappist monk Thomas Merton and His Holiness the 14th Dalai Lama met three times over eight days in Dharamsala, India. They compared day-to-day routines, prayer, and the goals of meditation within their respective Catholic and Buddhist traditions. A central point was the universality of compassion in both Christianity and Buddhism. The Dalai Lama later noted Merton's belief that one could be "perfectly faithful to Christianity, yet learn in depth from other religions".

 Merton noted that their conversations were almost entirely focused on religion, philosophy, and meditation techniques rather than politics. The Dalai Lama advised Merton to ground his interest in Tibetan mysticism with a study of Madhyamika philosophy, emphasizing the union of study and practice. In their final meeting, they briefly discussed the relationship between Marxist theory and monastic structures. 

Thomas Merton.wrote in his journals that he felt a "real spiritual bond" with the Dalai Lama, describing him as strong, energetic, and warm.

The Dalai Lama credits Merton with introducing him to the "real meaning of the word 'Christian'". He frequently names Merton as one of the three most influential people in his life, alongside his Dharma teacher and Mao Zedong. 

Their meeting occurred just weeks before Merton's untimely death in Bangkok in December 1968. The Thomas Merton Center and various interfaith initiatives continue to use their dialogue as a foundational model for "the dialogue of spiritual experience," where practitioners share the riches of their traditions to find common ground in compassion and mental peace."

She is the mother of Jomo Gichaga, Uhuru Kenyatta's former private secretary. This is a picture of Jomo Kenyatta in 1949 when used to teach at the college in Githunguri. မ၌ဆောင်ရွက်သည်။
ဦးစွာ (ဗဟို)ဥက္ကဋ္ဌ ဦးဝဏ္ဏကအဖွင့်အမှာစကားပြောကြား၍ဗဟို နာယက ဒေါက်တာ ညွန့်လှက နှုတ်ဆက်စကားပြောကြားသည်။
ဗဟို ဥက္ကဋ္ဌ အမှာစကားတွင် ယခုကျင်းပဆောင်ရွက်မည့် လူဂုဏ်သိက္ခာနှင့်ငြိမ်းချမ်းရေးဆုတောင်းပွဲအား
မိမိတို့ ဘာသာပေါင်းစုံချစ်ကြည်ညီညွတ်ရေးအဖွဲ့မှ ဘာသာကြီး(၄)ဘာသာမှစုပေါင်း၍သက်မှတ်နေရာတွင် အဆင်‌ပြေစွာဆောင်ရွက်သွားနိုင်ရေးနှင့်ဘာသာမတူညီကြသော်လည်း မြန်မာဘာသာ၊မြန်မာစကားဖြင့်သာ ဆုတောင်းပြောဆိုသွားကြရန်၊မိမိတို့အဖွဲ့ရှိသက်ဆိုင်ရာဘာသာအလိုက် တာဝန်ရှိသူများအနေ
ဖြင့် ယခုဆောင်ရွက်မည့် အခမ်းအနားအားသဘော
တူညီမှု(ရှိ/မရှိ)အား ဆန္ဒ ပြုကြရန်နှင့်ဆောင်ရွက်မည့် ကိစ္စအရပ်ရပ်များအား ရှင်းလင်းပြောကြားသည်။
ထို့နောက်အစည်းအဝေးတက်ရောက်လာကြသော၊
သက်ဆိုင်ရာဘာသာကြီး(၄)ရပ်မှ တာဝန်ရှိကြသူများက ကျင်းပဆောင်ရွက်မည့် အခမ်းအနားအား
ကန့်ကွက်ရန်မရှိပါကြောင်းနှင့်သဘောတူညီကြပါကြောင်း ဆန္ဒ ပြုပြောကြားကြသည်။
အစည်းအဝေးသို့ ဘာသာပေါင်းစုံချစ်ကြည်ညီညွတ်

Coordination Meeting Held in Preparation for the Peace Prayer Ceremony

6 January 2026

A preliminary coordination meeting for the upcoming Peace Prayer Ceremony, to be jointly organized by the Myanmar Interfaith Dialogue Organization and INGO PEACE (Japan), was held on 6 January 2026 at 1:00 p.m. at the Central Office Meeting Hall.

At the opening of the meeting, U Wunna, Chairman of the Myanmar Interfaith Dialogue Organization (Central), delivered the opening remarks, followed by welcome remarks by Dr. Nyunt Hla, Central Patron.

In his address, the Chairman explained that the forthcoming Human Dignity and Peace Prayer Ceremony would be conducted collectively by representatives of the four major religions, at a designated venue, in a smooth and orderly manner. He emphasized that although participants represent different faiths, all prayers and messages would be delivered in the Myanmar language. PRESS STATEMENT
DROUGHT SITUATION AND ONGOING INTERVENTIONS IN MANDERA COUNTY 

Mandera, 6th January 2026.

The drought situation in Mandera County remains critical, with the county currently classified in the Alarm drought phase, with a worsening trend. This follows consecutive seasons of below-average rainfall, prolonged dry spells, and poor rainfall distribution, which has significantly constrained the regeneration of pasture and water resources across the county.

As a result, livestock are trekking longer distances in search of water and pasture, leading to deterioration in body condition and reduced milk production. These impacts have weakened household purchasing power and undermined food and nutrition security, particularly among vulnerable groups, including children under five years, pregnant and lactating women, older persons, and persons with disabilities. We estimate that more than 335,000 people in the county currently require humanitarian assistance. 

In addition, livestock migration within Mandera County and into neighbouring Wajir County has been reported, increasing pressure on limited resources and heightening the risk of resource-based conflict.

This morning, I convened a County Steering Group meeting attended by the County Commissioner Mr. Charles Chacha, the Chief Executive Officer of the National Drought Management Authority (NDMA) Lt Col (Rtd) Hared Adan, County Secretary Mr. Billow Issack Hassan, Lafey Ward MCA Hon. Adan Hussein, County Executive Committee Members, the Frontier Counties Development Council represented by Mr. Abdirahman Abbas, technical departments, and humanitarian and development partners operating in the county. WFP team from both Wajir and Nairobi Virtually also joined us.

The meeting has reaffirmed the commitment of both levels of Government to safeguard lives and livelihoods. In this regard, the County and National Governments, working in close collaboration with humanitarian and development partners, are implementing a coordinated package of drought response measures across Mandera County:

Water trucking to 266 sites (203 domestic and 63 livestock sites) using 33 water bowsers across the county by the County Government.

Repair, drilling, and equipping of emergency boreholes by the County Government of Mandera, alongside food distribution to vulnerable households so far 39 boreholes have been drilled. 24 of this have been equipped and operational. The remaining 15 are been equipped now by the county Government and other Partners.

Fuel support for water trucking and strategic boreholes provided by NDMA to sustain water access for households and livestock.

Distribution of 15,000 bags of rice and 13,000 bags of beans by the State Department for Special Programmes.
Integrated health, nutrition, and WASH outreaches, including mass nutrition screening and disease surveillance, led by the County Government and partners.

Livestock vaccination and treatment programmes implemented by the County Government and RACIDA.
Cash transfers under the Hunger Safety Net Programme, implemented by NDMA, reaching 22,107 households to stabilise household purchasing power.

Cash transfers and nutrition support for malnourished children provided by the Kenya Red Cross Society and RACIDA.

In addition, the following interventions have been initiated:

Distribution of food to 67,000 households by the County Government.

Procurement of 7, 280 bags (50kgs) of livestock drought pellets by NDMA to be delivered between January and February. 

Cash transfers by World Food Programme from January to March to 7,992 households at KSh 7,000 per household per month.

Cash transfer by RACIDA from January to March – Targeting 7943 households with support from state department (OFA), DKH and ACTED with total amount KES 68,174,981 out of this 6385 will receive 8645 for three months, 384 households will receive 12277 for two months and 724 households receiving 11412 for two months. Similarly, RACIDA is also distributing non-food items to 1250 Households.
Provision of 8,064 bags (50kgs) of range cubes by FAO. 

Initiation of livestock feed and water interventions under World Bank–supported programmes under the Ministry of Agriculture, through which the County Government will access KSh 20 million for the supply of crop residues as livestock fodder. The feeds will be sold to pastoralists under a revolving fund mechanism to enhance sustainability.

Emerging risks and priority actions
If current conditions persist, Mandera County faces increased risks of livelihood asset depletion, worsening malnutrition, and heightened competition over scarce water and pasture resources, with potential implications for peace and security.

We have recommended the following priority actions across various sectors to mitigate further deterioration of the drought situation:

Food Assistance and Social Protection: Scale up cash transfers for vulnerable households and pre-positioning of food and non-food items for timely response.

Water: Expansion of water trucking for domestic and livestock needs, rehabilitation and equipping of strategic and emergency boreholes, provision of sustained fuel support for Government water bowsers, and deployment of additional community water storage facilities.

Livestock: Provision of emergency livestock feeds, implementation of targeted slaughter destocking, and scale up of veterinary services through essential drugs and vaccines.

Health and Nutrition: Scale up of integrated health, nutrition, and WASH services, intensified nutrition screening and hygiene promotion, pre-positioning of life-saving nutrition commodities, and blanket supplementary feeding in severely affected areas.

Education: Expansion of the school feeding programme, water trucking to learning institutions, and provision of storage tanks and hand-washing facilities.

Peace and Security: Enhanced early warning and conflict-prevention mechanisms, including community and cross-border peace dialogues, and strengthening the capacity of peace committees and conflict monitoring structures.

Agriculture: Support to irrigated agriculture through provision of farm inputs to farmers along the irrigated belt, including drought-tolerant seeds and pesticides, rehabilitation of irrigation infrastructure, fuel support for pumping systems, and promotion of climate-smart farming practices.

We acknowledge and appreciate the continued support of our partners, particularly the World Food Programme, RACIDA, International Organisation for Migration, Danish Refugee Council, Kenya Red Cross Society, Islamic Relief Worldwide, and Concern Worldwide, Organisation for Sustainable Development Africa (OSDA), among others.

We are strengthening coordination, mobilising additional resources, and synergising stakeholder response efforts to reduce duplication and ensure targeted support reaches the most affected communities as drought impacts escalate.

The County Government will continue to work closely with relevant National Government departments, including the NDMA, and partners to deliver a timely, coordinated, and effective response, while advancing longer-term drought resilience and recovery for communities across Mandera County.

7 January 1994, lifelong Jewish revolutionary Leah Feldman also known as Leah Downes, was cremated in London after dying aged approximately 94.

KIFUNGO CHA NAFSI KINACHOTOKANA NA AHADI NA VIAPO VYA MANENO
— Maneno ya moyoni yanayofunga hatima bila kutambuliwa

MCHUNGAJI OKHASO MAKOTSWE 

UTANGULIZI
Watu wengi wanaamini kuwa kifungo cha nafsi hutokana na ngono, ndoa au kuishi pamoja. Hili ni kweli kwa sehemu, lakini Biblia inatufunulia ukweli wa ndani zaidi:
kuna kifungo cha nafsi kinachozaliwa ndani ya moyo kupitia maneno, maamuzi na viapo vya kimya vinavyotamkwa wakati wa maumivu makali ya kihisia.

Biblia inasema:
> “Linda moyo wako kuliko vyote uvilindavyo, maana ndiko zitokako chemchemi za uzima.”
Mithali 4:23 (SUV)

Maana yake, moyo (nafsi) ni mahali pa kutokea maamuzi, mitazamo na mwelekeo wa maisha. Pale moyo unapojeruhiwa, nafsi hujilinda kwa kuapa kimya kimya, kusema ndani yake: sitapenda tena, sitaumini tena, sitafunguka tena.
Maneno haya yasiyotamkwa kwa sauti hugeuka kuwa ngome za rohoni.

Biblia pia inathibitisha nguvu ya maneno ya ndani:

> “Kifo na uzima i katika uwezo wa ulimi; nao wapendao kuutumia watakula matunda yake.”
Mithali 18:21 (SUV)

Hii ina maana kuwa hata maneno yanayosemwa moyoni yana uwezo wa kuunda uhalisia wa maisha. Wengi wanaendelea kufunga na kuomba, lakini bado wanarudia historia ile ile ya maumivu, si kwa sababu Mungu hajibu, bali kwa sababu nafsi bado imefungwa na ahadi za ndani ambazo hazijavunjwa.

Ndiyo maana maandiko yanasema:
> “Hunirudisha nafsi yangu; huniongoza katika njia za haki kwa ajili ya jina lake.”
Zaburi 23:3 (SUV)

Utangulizi huu unatufungua macho kuelewa kuwa uhuru wa kweli hauanzi kwenye hisia, bali kwenye kuvunjwa kwa viapo vya nafsi na kurejeshwa kwa moyo chini ya mamlaka ya Kristo.

A) TAMBUA KIFUNGO CHA NAFSI HUFUNGWA NDANI YA MTU MWENYEWE

Baada ya kuelewa kuwa kuna kifungo cha nafsi kinachozaliwa kupitia ahadi na viapo vya ndani, ni muhimu kutambua kuwa kifungo hiki mara nyingi hakifungwi na mtu mwingine, bali hujifungwa ndani ya mtu mwenyewe bila yeye kutambua. Hili hutokea pale nafsi inapojaribu kujilinda dhidi ya maumivu makubwa ya kihisia, hofu au kukatishwa tamaa.

Biblia inasema:
> “Moyo huwa mdanganyifu kuliko vitu vyote, una ugonjwa wa kufisha; nani awezaye kuujua?”
Yeremia 17:9 (SUV)

Andiko hili linafunua kuwa moyo wa mwanadamu unaweza kutengeneza maamuzi na ahadi zisizo sahihi hasa wakati wa jeraha. Wakati mtu anaumizwa kwenye mahusiano, nafsi hujenga kuta za kujilinda, na kuta hizi huendelea kukomaa hadi kuwa ngome za rohoni zinazoathiri namna ya kuamini, kupenda na kuchagua.

Biblia pia inasema:
> “Silaha za vita vyetu si za mwilini, bali zina nguvu katika Mungu hata kuangusha ngome.”
2 Wakorinto 10:4 (SUV)

Hii ina maana kuwa ngome nyingi hazionekani kwa macho, bali zipo katika fikra, kumbukumbu na maamuzi ya ndani. Kama ngome hizi hazitavunjwa, mtu anaweza kuingia katika mahusiano mapya lakini akiwa bado amefungwa na historia ya zamani.

Yesu alipouliza:
> “Wataka kupona?”
Yohana 5:6 (SUV)

Swali hili linaonesha wazi kuwa uhuru wa kweli hauji kwa muujiza peke yake, bali kwa uamuzi wa kuachilia vifungo vya ndani vya nafsi.

B)WENGI HAWAJAOLEWA TENA WALA HAWAJAOA TENA, KWASABABU YA NGOME ILIYOJENGWA NA MANENO 

Wapo watu wengi ambao baada ya kuumizwa kwenye mahusiano au ndoa, hawajaoa tena wala kuolewa tena, na badala ya kutambua chanzo cha hali hiyo, wanachukulia ni tabia, maamuzi ya kawaida au “nimezoea kuwa hivi.” Ukweli wa rohoni ni huu: mara nyingi si tabia, bali ni kifungo cha nafsi kilichozaliwa kwa maneno yao wenyewe.

Katika kipindi cha maumivu makali, wengi walitamka au kuapa kimya kimya wakisema:

> “SITAKUJA KUOLEWA TENA.”
“SITAKUJA KUOA TENA.”

Maneno haya hayakupita tu kama hisia, bali yalikaa rohoni kama viapo, na kwa kuyasema walijifunga wao wenyewe bila kujua. Biblia iko wazi kuhusu nguvu ya maneno:

> “Kifo na uzima i katika uwezo wa ulimi; nao wapendao kuutumia watakula matunda yake.”
Mithali 18:21 

Baada ya hapo, mtu anaendelea kuomba, kufunga na hata kwenda kwa manabii akitafuta kuolewa au kuoa, akitafuta mchawi au adui wa nje, kumbe chanzo cha kifungo kipo ndani yake mwenyewe—ni neno aliloliachia rohoni wakati wa jeraha.

Biblia inasema:
> “Mtego wa mtu ni maneno ya kinywa chake; hunaswa kwa maneno ya kinywa chake.”
Mithali 6:2 

Hii ina maana kuwa kuna watu hawajafungwa na mtu, hawajafungwa na pepo, wala hawajafungwa kwa uchawi, bali wamenaswa na maneno yao wenyewe. Ndiyo sababu, mpaka maneno yale yavunjwe na kufutwa kwa mamlaka ya Kristo, nafsi itaendelea kubaki ndani ya kifungo ilichojijengea yenyewe.

C) MANENO ULIYOTAMKA HUTENGEZA KIFUNGO  KWENYE MAHUSIANO

Wakati wa mahusiano, hasa katika nyakati za maumivu, hasira au kuvunjika moyo, watu wengi hutamka maneno bila kujua kuwa wanajenga vifungo vya rohoni. Maneno haya hayapotei hewani; huingia kwenye nafsi na kuanza kutawala maamuzi, mitazamo na hatima ya maisha ya baadaye.

Wakati mtu anaposema:
> “SITAPENDA TENA.”
“NDOA SIYO YA KWANGU.”
“WANAWAKE/WANAUME WOTE NI WABAYA.”

Maneno haya hubadilika kuwa ahadi za ndani (inner vows) zinazojifunga rohoni. Biblia inathibitisha hili wazi:

> “Kwa maneno yako utahesabiwa haki, na kwa maneno yako utahukumiwa.”
Mathayo 12:37 (SUV)

Wengi wanafikiri kifungo cha mahusiano hutokana na ngono au kuachana tu, lakini ukweli wa kibiblia ni kwamba maneno ndiyo hufunga zaidi kuliko matendo. Ndiyo maana maandiko yanasema:

> “Mtego wa mtu ni maneno ya kinywa chake; hunaswa kwa maneno ya kinywa chake.”
Mithali 6:2 (SUV)

Baada ya hapo, mtu anaweza kuingia kwenye mahusiano mapya, lakini akashindwa kupenda, kuamini au kuendelea, kwa sababu nafsi bado inatii maneno ya zamani. Anaomba, anafunga, anatafuta msaada, lakini ndani kuna sauti inayoendelea kusema “ulifanya uamuzi tayari.”

Biblia inatukumbusha:
> “Usife kwa njaa kwa kukosa neno, lakini roho itaangamizwa kwa kukosa maarifa.”
Hosea 4:6 (SUV)

👉 Maneno uliyotamka kwenye maumivu yanaweza kuwa ndiyo kifungo kinachozuia mustakabali wako wa mahusiano leo, mpaka yatakapovunjwa kwa nuru ya Neno la Mungu na mamlaka ya Yesu Kristo.

DALILI ZA MTU ALIYEFUNGWA NA KIFUNGO CHA MANENO

1)ANAJIKUTA AMETAMKIA WATU WENGI NA HAJUI NANI NI NANI

Mtu aliyefungwa na kifungo cha maneno aliyoyatamka kwenye mahusiano hupoteza mwelekeo wa kihisia na kiroho. Anajikuta ametamkiana ahadi, maneno ya mapenzi au viapo kwa watu wengi tofauti, bila utambuzi wa nani hasa ni wa hatima yake na nani siyo. Kwa nje anaonekana kupendwa na wengi, lakini ndani nafsi yake imekamatwa na kila aliyemtamkia neno.

Hii hutokea kwa sababu kila neno la kina linalotamkwa hutengeneza muunganiko wa nafsi, na nafsi inapogawanyika mara nyingi, hushindwa kufanya uamuzi sahihi. Biblia inasema:

> “Kuna njia ionekanayo kuwa sawa machoni pa mtu, lakini mwisho wake ni njia za mauti.”
Mithali 14:12 (SUV)

Kwa sababu nafsi imefungwa na maneno mengi ya zamani, mtu huanza:

Kulinganisha watu
Kuchanganyikiwa kihisia
Kushindwa kujitoa kikamilifu kwa mtu mmoja
Kuweka kila mtu sawa machoni pake

Biblia inaonya kuhusu hali ya moyo uliogawanyika:

NAMNA YA KUONDOA KIFUNGO CHA NAFSI YA MANENO
1. KUTAMBUA KIFUNGO CHA NDANI
Hatua ya kwanza na ya muhimu zaidi katika kuponya nafsi ni kutambua chanzo cha kweli cha kifungo chako. Mara nyingi, tunatafuta sababu za nje kama watu wengine, nguvu za giza, au kile tunachokiita "hatima mbaya," lakini ukweli ni kwamba tatizo kuu linaweza kuwa ndani yetu wenyewe. Kifungo hiki hutokana na maneno uliyoyatamka, ahadi uliyojiwekea, au viapo vya ndani ulivyovitoa wakati wa majeraha. Hivi ni vifungo vya kisheria vya kiroho ambavyo umejifunga mwenyewe, na mpaka uvitambue, huwezi kuwa huru.

Kama neno la Mungu linavyosema katika Yakobo 1:8, "Mtu wa moyo wa shaka si thabiti katika njia zake zote." Hii inamaanisha kuwa migogoro ya ndani inazuia hatua zako za maendeleo. Ili kuvunja hali hii, ni lazima uchukue hatua ya makusudi ya kuandika au kutaja maneno yote uliyoyasema wakati wa maumivu makali, kama vile kusema: "Sitapenda tena," "Sitafungamana na mtu yeyote," au "Watu wote ni wabaya." Lengo la zoezi hili ni kuleta yale mambo yaliyojificha gizani kwenye nuru ili yaweze kushughulikiwa; si jambo la kuogopa, bali ni hatua ya kuelekea uhuru wa kweli.

2. KUTUBIA NA KUSAMEHE
Baada ya kutambua maneno yaliyokufunga, hatua inayofuata ni kuitakasa nafsi yako kupitia toba ya kweli. 

Hii inahusisha kukiri dhambi, makosa, na yale maneno yote hasi uliyoyatamka huko nyuma ambayo yamekuwa mtego kwako. Toba ni lango la kurejesha uhusiano wako na Mungu na kuondoa uhalali wa adui kutumia maneno yako dhidi yako.

 Unapaswa kuachilia kila neno la laana au la kukatisha tamaa ulilojielekezea mwenyewe, ukiamini kuwa neema ya Mungu inatosha kufuta makosa hayo na kukupa mwanzo mpya.

Sambamba na toba, ni lazima umsamehe kila mtu aliyekuumiza, bila kujali ukubwa wa jeraha alilokuachia. Kupitia nguvu ya Kristo, unapaswa kuachilia uchungu huo hata kama huwezi kuonana na mtu huyo ana kwa ana; msamaha ni uamuzi wa moyoni, si hisia. 

Kama neno la Mungu linavyotukumbusha katika Mathayo 6:14-15, "Kama mnasamehe dhambi za watu, Baba wenu wa mbinguni atawasamehe nanyi." Kumbuka kuwa msamaha ni ufunguo wa gereza ulilokuwa umefungwa; unaposamehe, unajifungua mwenyewe.
Hatua ya Kuchukua:

Tamka  kwa imani maneno haya yafuatayo kama tamko la uhuru wako: 

“Ninasamehe kila mtu aliyenikosea kwa dhati, na pia ninajisamehe mwenyewe kwa maneno na ahadi zote mbaya za zamani nilizojitamkia.”

3. KUVUNJA VIAPO VYA NDANI KIBIBLIA
Baada ya kutambua na kutubu, unaingia katika hatua ya mapambano ya kiroho ya kuvunja vifungo kwa mamlaka. 

Hatua hii ni tukio la nguvu kubwa kwani inahusisha kubomoa kisheria kila neno ambalo lilikua limejenga "ngome" kwenye akili na nafsi yako.
 Maneno yote ya ndani uliyoyatamka wakati wa kukata tamaa yanapaswa kuvunjwa kwa kutumia Mamlaka ya Jina la Yesu Kristo. Ni lazima utamke kwa ujasiri kuwa kila kifungo, kila ahadi uliyojipa mwenyewe, na kila kiapo kilichobana maisha yako sasa vimebatilishwa na havina nguvu tena juu yako.

Neno la Mungu katika 2 Wakorinto 10:4 linatuthibitishia kuwa, 

"Silaha za vita vyetu si za mwilini, bali zina nguvu katika Mungu hata kuangusha ngome." 

Hii ina maana kuwa unapotumia jina la Yesu, unatumia silaha inayoweza kubomoa kuta za kisaikolojia na kiroho ambazo zimekuzuia kwa miaka mingi. Huu ni wakati wa kutumia kinywa chako kama chombo cha ukombozi; unapotamka kuvunja viapo hivyo, unaharibu ramani ya zamani ya maumivu na kuruhusu nafsi yako kupumua upya katika uhuru wa Kristo.
Hatua ya Kuchukua:

Tumia sala hii ya nguvu, ukiisema kwa sauti ya mamlaka au kwa umakini mkubwa moyoni mwako: “Kwa mamlaka ya Yesu Kristo, ninaacha na kuvunja kila ahadi isiyo na maana niliyojifunga kwayo. Ninavunja kila kiapo na neno lililobana nafsi yangu, na sasa ninachukua uhuru wangu kamili wa ndani kwa nguvu ya Damu ya Yesu.”

4. KUPATA UHURU WA KIROHO
Baada ya kuvunja vifungo vya zamani, hatua ya mwisho na ya kudumu ni kuanza kuishi katika uhalisia wa uhuru wako mpya. 

Uhuru wa kweli wa kiroho hauthibitishwi tu kwa kile ulichokiacha, bali kwa kile unachoanza kukijenga ndani yako kuanzia sasa. 

Ni lazima ubadilishe mfumo wako wa usemi na kuanza kuishi kwa mafanikio ya maneno mapya yenye nguvu ya imani, mapenzi, amani, na matumaini. Badala ya kuta za ulinzi ulizozijenga kwa hofu, sasa unajenga madaraja ya heri kupitia maneno ya uzima yanayokubaliana na mapenzi ya Mungu kwa maisha yako.

Neno la Mungu katika Zaburi 23:3 linatoa ahadi ya urejesho kwa kusema, 

"Hunirudisha nafsi yangu; huniongoza katika njia za haki kwa ajili ya jina lake." 

Huu ni wakati wa kukubali kuwa Mungu anaiponya nafsi yako na kuifanya iwe mpya tena. Unapokiri maneno ya imani, unaruhusu nuru ya Mungu itawale kila sehemu ya moyo wako iliyokuwa na giza. 

Huu si mchakato wa siku moja, bali ni maisha ya kila siku ya kujikumbusha kuwa wewe ni kiumbe kipya, uliye huru kupokea na kutoa upendo, na uliye tayari kuona wema wa Mungu katika nchi ya walio hai.

Hatua ya Kuchukua (Sema na Andika Kila Siku):
“Nina uhuru kamili wa kupenda, kuamini, na kufungamana na wema wa Mungu katika kila eneo la maisha yangu. Nafsi yangu imerejeshwa, na sasa ninatembea katika njia za haki na amani.”

5. KUSIMAMA NA KUDUMU KATIKA IMANI 
Uhuru wa nafsi si tukio la mara moja tu, bali ni safari ya kila siku ya kulinda moyo wako na akili yako. 
Ili kudumu katika uhuru ulioupata, ni lazima ujenge tabia ya makusudi ya kufanya maombi, kutafakari neno la Mungu, na kutamka maneno mapya ya uhuru kila asubuhi na jioni.

 Unapochangia imani yako kwa namna hii, unazuia nafsi yako isirudi tena kwenye mifumo ya zamani ya mawazo hasi na maneno ya kifo.

 Kila neno unalotamka leo ni mbegu; hakikisha unapanda mbegu za uzima ili uvune matunda ya amani na ushindi katika maisha yako ya baadaye.
Nguvu ya kudumu katika uhuru huu inatoka kwa Roho Mtakatifu anayefanya kazi ndani yako.

 Kama neno la Mungu linavyosema katika 2 Timotheo 1:7, "Kwa maana Mungu hakutupa roho ya hofu, bali ya nguvu, upendo na nidhamu."

 Unapojisomea na kuyatafakari maneno haya, unajijengea ulinzi wa kiroho (nidhamu ya nafsi) unaokusaidia kukataa sauti yoyote ya mashaka au hofu inayoweza kujaribu kukurudisha utumwani. Kumbuka, kadiri unavyozidi kusema maneno ya uhuru, ndivyo unavyozidi kuwa thabiti na imara katika utu wako wa ndani.
Hatua ya Kuchukua:

Tenga muda maalum kila siku wa kukaa kimya na kutafakari wema wa Mungu. Tumia dakika chache kusema kwa sauti: “Leo ninachagua kutembea katika nguvu, upendo, na nidhamu ya Kristo. Ninakataa kila mfumo wa zamani wa maneno, na ninaishi katika upya wa nafsi yangu kila saa

HITIMISHO: 
Ukombozi wa nafsi kutoka katika vifungo vya maneno ni mchakato wa kimungu unaomrejesha mwanadamu katika asili ya kusudi lake. 

Mtu yeyote aliyekuwa amenaswa na minyororo ya maneno ya maumivu, laana, au viapo vya ndani, anaweza kupata uhuru kamili na wa kudumu. 

Safari hii inakamilika pale tu mhusika anapopita katika hatua muhimu za kutambua chanzo cha kifungo chake, kutubu kwa unyenyekevu, na kuvunja viapo vyote vya ndani kwa mamlaka ya jina la Yesu. Hapa ndipo mlango wa gereza la nafsi unafunguka na kuruhusu nuru ya Mungu iingie ndani.

Uhuru huu unadumishwa na kuimarishwa pale mtu anapoamua kwa makusudi kuanza kuishi na kutamka maneno mapya ya imani. Kwa kutegemea nguvu isiyoshindwa ya Neno la Mungu na Damu ya Yesu Kristo, unakuwa si tu mshindi, bali mshindi zaidi ya washindi. Gisèle Pelicot thought she had a good marriage.
Fifty years with Dominique. Three children. Grandchildren. A retirement home in Provence with a garden and swimming pool. Friends who said they were "the perfect couple."
She had no idea.
For years, Gisèle experienced strange symptoms. She'd wake up exhausted. Sometimes she couldn't remember chunks of time. Her hair started falling out. She developed gynecological problems doctors couldn't explain.

She asked her husband once if he was drugging her.
He looked hurt. He denied it. She believed him.
She always believed him.
November 2, 2020. Gisèle received a call from police. They needed her to come to the station immediately.
When she arrived, they sat her down and told her something that shattered her entire reality.
Dominique had been caught filming up women's skirts in a supermarket. When police seized his computer, they found something far worse: thousands of photos and videos.

Of Gisèle. Unconscious. Being raped.
By Dominique. By strangers. In her own bed.
"Everything caved in," she later testified. "Everything I built for 50 years."
The evidence was overwhelming and horrifying. For nearly a decade—from 2011 to 2020—Dominique had been crushing sleeping pills and anti-anxiety medication into Gisèle's food and drink.

Once she was unconscious, he would rape her. He'd dress her in lingerie she'd never wear. He'd position her body. He'd film everything.
Then he started inviting others.
Dominique found them on a website called Coco, on a forum literally titled "à son insu"—"without her knowledge." He'd post that he and his wife shared a "fetish" for her being unconscious during sex.

He never said outright that he was drugging her. But the men who responded knew. Or they should have known.
Over nine years, Dominique recruited approximately 50 men to come to their home in Mazan and rape his unconscious wife. He filmed it all. He kept meticulous records.
Firefighter. Journalist. Nurse. Truck driver. Soldier. Prison guard. Local councilor.
Men from all walks of life. Ages 26 to 74. Many were married. Some had children.

They came to a quiet house in Provence. They entered through the back door. They climbed the stairs. They raped an unconscious 60-something woman while her husband filmed.
Then they left.
Some came once. Some came multiple times over the years.
Gisèle knew none of this. She woke up tired, confused about lost time, experiencing physical symptoms she couldn't explain. She trusted her doctor husband when he said it was stress, age, menopause.

She never suspected the man sleeping beside her was destroying her.
When police showed her the evidence in November 2020, Gisèle's world ended. The man she'd loved since 1971. The father of her children. Her partner of fifty years.
He'd been raping her for nearly a decade. He'd invited dozens of strangers to do the same.
And he'd filmed everything.

Dominique was arrested immediately. Between his arrest in September and being formally detained in November, police discovered he'd continued inviting men to rape Gisèle.
Even after being caught. He kept doing it.
Gisèle filed for divorce. She moved out of the family home. She didn't see Dominique again until September 2024—when the trial began.
Fifty-one men were charged. Dominique and 50 others who'd been identified from the videos.
As a rape victim, Gisèle had the right to remain anonymous. The trial could have been held behind closed doors, sparing her from public scrutiny.
She refused.

At 72 years old, Gisèle Pelicot walked into that courtroom in Avignon and said her name publicly. She waived her right to anonymity. She demanded the trial be public.
She wanted the world to see what had been done to her.
"Shame must change sides," she declared.

She was done carrying shame for crimes committed against her. She wanted the shame to land where it belonged: on the rapists.
The trial lasted nearly four months. Gisèle attended almost every day.
She sat in that courtroom while videos of her unconscious body being raped were played on screens. She listened to defendants claim they thought it was consensual. She heard men argue that her husband's permission was enough.
She watched as some defendants admitted guilt while others insisted they'd been tricked—as if an unconscious woman could consent to anything.

Dominique confessed. "I am a rapist," he told the court, "like the others in this room."
But many of the others refused to accept that label. They claimed they believed Gisèle was awake and pretending to be asleep. They said they thought it was a game.
The evidence—thousands of photos and videos showing Gisèle clearly unconscious, limp, unresponsive—said otherwise.
Throughout the trial, Gisèle maintained her dignity. She spoke clearly about what had happened. She refused to be ashamed.
Every day when she left court, crowds of supporters—mostly women—applauded her. They held signs: "Gisèle, we believe you." "Thank you for your courage." "Shame changes sides."

She became more than a survivor of rape. She became a symbol.
December 19, 2024. Verdict day.
All 51 men were found guilty.
Dominique Pelicot received the maximum sentence: 20 years in prison. At 72, he'll likely die in custody.
The other 50 men received sentences ranging from 3 to 15 years. Some activists felt the sentences were too light. But all 51 were convicted.
Every single one.

After the verdicts, Gisèle addressed reporters outside the courthouse.
"I wanted to open the doors of this trial so that society could see what was happening," she said. "I never regretted this decision."
She spoke to other victims whose stories remain untold, whose trauma stays hidden.
"We share the same fight," she told them.
The impact was seismic.
France began a national conversation about rape culture, consent, and drug-facilitated sexual assault. The case sparked protests worldwide. Women across the globe saw Gisèle's courage and found their own voices.

She was named to BBC's 100 Women list. TIME magazine honored her. The Financial Times called her one of the most influential women of 2024. In a French opinion poll, she was named personality of the year—beating world leaders.
On July 14, 2025—Bastille Day—France awarded Gisèle Pelicot its highest honor: knight of the Legion of Honour.

President Emmanuel Macron publicly praised her as a trailblazer whose "dignity and courage moved and inspired France and the world."
She also received Normandy's Prix de Liberté. The €25,000 prize money? She donated it to the victims association in Avignon that had supported her during the trial.
Now Gisèle is preparing to share her full story.
Her memoir, A Hymn to Life, will be published January 27, 2026, in over 20 languages simultaneously.
"I am immensely grateful for the extraordinary support I have received," she said when announcing the book. "I now want to tell my story in my own words."

"Through this book, I hope to convey a message of strength and courage to all those who are subjected to difficult ordeals. May they never feel shame. And in time, may they even learn to savor life again and find peace."
Think about what Gisèle Pelicot did.
She could have kept her anonymity. She could have hidden from the world's gaze. She could have processed her trauma privately, away from cameras and headlines.
Instead, she stood up. She said her name. She forced the world to witness what had been done to her.

She took the shame that rape culture places on victims—the silence, the stigma, the blame—and she handed it back to the men who'd committed the crimes.
"It's not for us to feel shame," she said. "It's for them."
For nine years, Gisèle was violated while unconscious. She had no voice, no knowledge, no control.
But when she woke up to the truth, she found her voice. And she used it to change the conversation for millions of women worldwide.
Sexual violence thrives in silence. It relies on victims feeling too ashamed to speak, too afraid to be judged, too broken to fight.
Gisèle Pelicot shattered that silence.

At 72, after enduring the unthinkable, she stood in open court and said: Look at what they did to me. See the evidence. Hear the truth. Shame is theirs, not mine.
Her daughter Caroline wrote a book called I'll Never Call Him Dad Again and started a nonprofit called M'endors Pas—"Don't Sedate Me"—to raise awareness of drug-facilitated sexual assault.

Her three children supported her throughout the trial, sitting beside her as evidence of their father's crimes was presented.
The family was destroyed by Dominique's actions. But they stood together in survival.
Gisèle's impact extends far beyond her own case.
In France, her trial sparked demands for changing the legal definition of rape to explicitly include consent—making it clear that unconsciousness means automatic lack of consent.

Globally, conversations about drug-facilitated sexual assault intensified. Women started questioning unexplained memory gaps, mysterious symptoms, relationships that seemed perfect but felt wrong.
And survivors of sexual violence saw Gisèle and thought: If she can speak, maybe I can too.
That's why her story matters.
Not just because of the horrific crimes committed against her. Not just because of the justice she eventually received.

But because Gisèle Pelicot proved that survivors don't have to carry shame. That speaking the truth—even when it's painful, even when the world is watching—is an act of resistance.
That it's never too late to reclaim your narrative.
Gisèle lost nearly a decade of her life to violation she didn't know was happening. She lost the marriage she thought she had. She lost the man she thought she loved.
But she didn't lose her voice.
And now, as she prepares to share her memoir, that voice will reach millions more women who need to hear it.

Women who've been told to stay quiet. Women who've been made to feel ashamed. Women who've carried the burden of crimes committed against them.
Gisèle's message to them is clear:
You are not alone. Your story deserves to be heard. Shame belongs to those who harmed you, not to you.
And it is never, ever too late to speak your truth.

She was 14 when they handed her a gun and asked, "Can you shoot a Nazi?" She said yes. Then she spent 70 years unable to forget their faces.
The Netherlands, May 1940.
German bombers filled the sky. Paratroopers dropped behind Dutch lines. The blitzkrieg was unstoppable. Within five days, the country surrendered.
Freddie Oversteegen was fourteen years old. She should have been worried about homework, friends, and first crushes.
Instead, within months, she'd be killing Nazis.
The Invitation
Freddie and her older sister Truus grew up in Haarlem with their mother Trijntje—a fierce anti-fascist who'd been hiding Jewish refugees in their tiny apartment even before the invasion.
When organized resistance networks formed across occupied Netherlands, Trijntje's commander approached her with a chilling proposal: Could her daughters help?
The logic was ruthlessly practical. Nazi soldiers didn't see teenage girls as threats. They saw them as harmless. Pretty. Insignificant.
That invisibility made them perfect weapons.
In 1940, Freddie (age 14) and Truus (age 16) joined the Haarlem resistance cell. They were the youngest members by far.
They would become some of the deadliest.
The Work Begins
At first, their assignments seemed almost safe: distributing illegal newspapers, smuggling Jewish children to hiding places, forging documents, delivering coded messages.
Dangerous, yes. But not violent.
Then one day, Freddie's commander handed her a gun.
She'd never held one before. The weapon felt impossibly heavy in her small hands.
The commander looked at her seriously. "Can you shoot a Nazi?"
Freddie thought about the families disappearing into the night. The deportations. The fear strangling every street. The occupation crushing her country.
"Yes," she said.
She was fourteen years old.
The Honey Trap
The tactic was devastatingly simple.
Freddie or Truus would dress like ordinary teenage girls. Ribbons in their hair. Innocent smiles. Pretty dresses. Always a bicycle—the most common Dutch transportation.
They'd ride through occupied streets, past checkpoints, past German patrols. Looking completely harmless. Just another girl running errands.
Then they'd approach a target: a Nazi officer known for brutality, a collaborator who'd betrayed Jews to the Gestapo, an informant whose information had led to executions.
Freddie would make eye contact. Smile shyly. Flirt just enough.
"Would you like to go for a walk with me?"
"I know a beautiful spot in the woods..."
"It's very private..."
The man—flattered, aroused, utterly unsuspecting—would follow this pretty teenage girl into the trees.
Where resistance fighters waited in ambush.
Sometimes the ambush team handled the execution.
Sometimes Freddie pulled the trigger herself.
She was fourteen. Fifteen. Sixteen.
The Team
Freddie wasn't working alone.
Her sister Truus was equally committed, equally deadly. Soon they partnered with another young woman who would become a legend: Hannie Schaft—"the girl with the red hair."
Hannie was a university law student who'd watched Nazis arrest her Jewish friends and decided academia could wait. She joined the resistance and discovered she was exceptionally good at sabotage, theft, and when necessary, assassination.
Smart. Fearless. Absolutely ruthless when the mission required it.
The three young women became legendary in the Dutch resistance. They blew up railway bridges. Derailed trains carrying German weapons. Stole Nazi supplies. Executed collaborators whose betrayals had sent Jews to death camps.
All while maintaining their cover as ordinary girls riding bicycles around town.
Living with Terror
Every single mission could have been their last.
One mistake—one suspicious soldier, one slip in their story, one observant neighbor—meant arrest, torture, execution.
They all carried cyanide capsules hidden in their clothes. A final option if capture seemed inevitable.
Freddie was 14, then 15, then 16.
Truus was 16, then 17, then 18.
Hannie was 19, then 20, then 21.
They should have been worrying about school dances and first jobs.
Instead, they were memorizing Nazi patrol schedules and learning to kill without hesitation.
The Tragedy
The Nazis knew someone was hunting their officers. They searched relentlessly.
Hannie Schaft became one of the most wanted resistance fighters in the Netherlands. Her distinctive red hair made her recognizable, so she dyed it black and constantly changed her appearance.
But on March 21, 1945—with Allied forces advancing, with liberation tantalizingly close—Hannie was stopped at a checkpoint.
Something about her didn't match. The soldiers found an illegal pistol.
She was arrested immediately.
Three weeks later, on April 17, 1945—just days before the Netherlands would be liberated—Hannie Schaft was executed in the dunes near Haarlem.
She was twenty-four years old.
When the first shot didn't kill her instantly, she reportedly told the executioner: "I shoot better than you."
Freddie and Truus survived the war. But they never forgot Hannie.
The Long Silence
May 5, 1945. Liberation Day. The war was over.
But for Freddie, the battle was just beginning.
She had what we now recognize as severe PTSD, though in 1945 there was no such diagnosis for young women. Nightmares. Flashbacks. Guilt that gnawed constantly.
She'd killed people. She'd watched friends die. She'd lived a double life so consuming that returning to "normal" felt impossible.
And the Netherlands—like most countries after the war—didn't know what to do with women like her.
Male resistance fighters were celebrated in parades, honored with medals, their stories retold endlessly.
Women resistance fighters were largely ignored or treated as curiosities rather than heroes.
So Freddie did what countless survivors do: she stayed quiet.
She married. Had children. Worked as an artist. Lived a modest life in the Dutch suburbs.
For decades—thirty, forty, fifty years—she didn't talk about the war.
Not because she was ashamed. But because nobody really wanted to hear the truth.
They wanted heroic stories with clean narratives. They wanted brave soldiers in uniforms following orders.
They didn't want to hear about a fourteen-year-old girl flirting with Nazi officers and shooting them in the woods.
Breaking the Silence
In the 2000s and 2010s, a new generation of historians found her.
Journalists. Filmmakers. Researchers determined to uncover women's resistance stories during World War II.
Freddie finally started talking.
Not to glorify what she'd done. Not to claim heroism. But to make sure it wasn't forgotten.
She spoke at schools to stunned teenagers who could barely imagine what she'd experienced at their age. She told her story plainly, without embellishment:
"We were terrified every single day. But we did it anyway."
"We didn't feel like heroes. It was simply the right thing to do, and somebody had to do it."
"I can still see their faces. All of them. That never goes away."
Recognition—Finally
In 2014, the Dutch government officially recognized Freddie and Truus's wartime service.
They were awarded the Mobilization War Cross—one of the Netherlands' highest civilian honors.
The ceremony took place seventy years after their resistance work.
Freddie was 88 years old. Truus was 90.
Seven decades. That's how long it took for their country to properly acknowledge what they'd sacrificed as teenagers.
But when asked about the delay, Freddie didn't seem bitter:
"People need to know what happened. What we did. What it cost us. Not for our glory—but so they understand what resistance really means."
The End
Truus Oversteegen died in 2016, at age 92.
Freddie Oversteegen died on September 5, 2018, at age 92—one day before her 93rd birthday.
They'd both lived long lives. They'd seen their children grow up, met grandchildren, created art, found moments of joy and peace.
But the war never truly left them. The faces never faded. The weight never fully lifted.
Why This Matters
Freddie Oversteegen's story is profoundly uncomfortable.
We want our heroes to be simple. To resist without violence. To be morally uncomplicated.
But war—especially occupation by genocidal fascists—doesn't offer those clean choices.
Freddie Oversteegen was fourteen years old when she started killing Nazis.
Not because she was naturally violent.
Not because she enjoyed it.
Not because she wanted to be a hero.
But because in occupied Netherlands, doing the right thing—protecting the innocent, resisting evil, saving lives—sometimes meant doing terrible things that would haunt you forever.
She never pretended it was easy. Or glorious. Or noble. Or without cost.
She just said it was necessary.
And she carried that necessity like a stone in her chest for seventy years.
Her true legacy isn't about movies or medals or belated honors.
It's about these truths:
Courage isn't the absence of fear—it's acting despite terror that threatens to paralyze you.
Heroism isn't comfortable or clean—it's doing what must be done, even when it costs you your peace, your innocence, your sleep for the rest of your life.
Sometimes the people who change history aren't soldiers in uniform following orders. They're kids on bicycles with ribbons in their hair—and steel in their hearts.
And resistance isn't glorious. It's ugly and frightening and morally complicated and it leaves scars that never fully heal.
But sometimes it's also absolutely necessary.

Three teenage girls who fought Nazis with bicycles, pistols, and courage most adults never find.
They didn't feel like heroes.
But history—finally, belatedly, gratefully—remembers them as exactly that.

Wananchi wanasema mpango huo unaendeshwa kwa maslahi ya watu wachache wenye nguvu, bila ridhaa ya jamii husika, jambo linalozua hofu juu ya uendelevu wa uporaji wa ardhi katika eneo hilo.
Wananchi wanasema wao wenyewe wamegomea uamuzi huo kwa kuona dalili nyingi za udanganyifu na ukiukwaji wa haki za umiliki wa ardhi, wakidai eneo hilo ni la jamii na lina historia, thamani ya kiutamaduni pamoja na kihisia, hasa kutokana na uwepo wa makaburi.
Kwa mujibu wa taarifa za wananchi, takribani miaka tisa iliyopita, Serikali ya Kata, Serikali ya Mtaa na Halmashauri kwa kushirikiana na aliyejitambulisha kama “Mwekezaji” (Hewa), walichukua ardhi ya wananchi, mashamba pamoja na makaburi kwa madai ya kulipa fidia. Hata hivyo, fidia hiyo inadaiwa kulipwa kwa njia za kiuongozi na ujanja ujanja, huku eneo kubwa zaidi ya hekari 100 katikati ya kata likichukuliwa kwa ahadi ya kujengwa kiwanda cha saruji (cement).
Mpaka leo, wananchi wanasema hakuna kiwanda kilichojengwa, wala maelezo ya wazi juu ya hatima ya mradi huo, jambo linaloongeza mashaka kuwa mradi huo ulikuwa kisingizio cha kupora ardhi ya wananchi.
Kutokana na uzoefu huo mchungu, wananchi wa Mzizima wanasema sasa wameshtukia njama za viongozi wachache wanaotumia mwavuli wa uwekezaji kujinufaisha binafsi. Hivyo, wameungana kwa mshikamano kukataa uuzwaji wowote wa eneo la Sega pamoja na maeneo mengine ya kijamii.
Aidha, kwa zaidi ya miaka kumi sasa, wananchi wamekuwa wakipambana kutaka serikali itenge rasmi maeneo ya makazi kwa ajili yao, bila mafanikio. Kila mara wamekuwa wakipewa ahadi mpya na kalenda mpya, lakini mwisho wa siku wameendelea kuitwa “wavamizi” katika ardhi wanayoishi kizazi hadi kizazi. Maeneo mengine yanayodaiwa kuwindwa ni Forest, Mleni, Mtambo wa Lami, pamoja na Rubawa, eneo ambalo wananchi wanasema tayari limeshauzwa au kuhamishwa kwa siri kwenda Mkinga.
Wananchi wa Mzizima wameitaka Serikali kusikiliza kilio chao, kufanya uchunguzi wa kina, na kusitisha mara moja mipango yote ya uuzwaji wa ardhi bila ridhaa ya wananchi. Wamesisitiza kuwa ardhi si mali ya mtu mmoja wala kundi dogo, bali ni urithi wa vizazi.

Watanzania wenzangu,
Mwaka 2025 ulianza kwa Chadema kuandika historia muhimu katika demokrasia ya ndani ya chama. Kupitia Mkutano Mkuu wa Taifa, wanachama walitumia haki yao ya msingi ya kidemokrasia kuchagua viongozi wao kwa uhuru, uwazi na uwajibikaji.

Katika mchakato huo, Ndugu Tundu Antipas Lissu alichaguliwa kuwa Mwenyekiti wa Taifa wa Chadema, akirithi uongozi kutoka kwa Ndugu Freeman Aikaeli Mbowe, ambaye alikitumikia chama kwa takribani miaka 21 kwa ujasiri na kujitoa sana. Sambamba na hilo, MIMI John Wegesa Heche nilichaguliwa kuwa Makamu Mwenyekiti Bara, na Ndugu Said Mzee kuwa Makamu Mwenyekiti Zanzibar, na baraza kuu la chama liliwathibitisha Ndugu John Mnyika kuwa Katibu Mkuu, Ndugu Amani Golugwa kuwa Naibu Katibu Mkuu Bara na Ndugu Ali Ibrahim Juma kuwa Naibu Katibu Mkuu Zanzibar, pamoja na wajumbe watano (5) wa Kamati Kuu ya chama.

Uchaguzi huu haukuwa tukio la chama pekee ulikuwa ni ushahidi wa vitendo, kwamba demokrasia inawezekana Tanzania — kwamba taasisi zinaweza kuheshimu katiba zao, kwamba uongozi unaweza kubadilika kwa amani, na kwamba tofauti za mawazo zinaweza kusimamiwa kwa heshima. Hii ndiyo Tanzania tunayoitaka.

Leo ninapotoa salamu hizi ni siku ya 269, tangu Mwenyekiti wetu Ndg. Chadema na Watanzania kwa ujasiri tunajivunia kuwa na Tundu Antipas Lissu kama tunu katika Taifa letu, mtetezi wa haki na mwenye kupinga uonevu, mtetezi wa utawala wa sheria, demokrasia na rasilimali za nchi na ambaye amesimama katika misingi ya kusema ukweli.
